"You're amazing, Tsuyoshi! So dependable, Tsuyoshi! Master Tsuyoshiii!"

Hmm. The stores bigger than this are one nearby and two further out... huh.
But today's pretty much the only day I have free all day, so—
Hwah!?
On my day off, while stopping by a bookstore during shopping—
Ehehe... Ehehehe... Ehehehehe...♪

Fufufu... Having trouble, I see!
Fear not, for you have nothing to worry about. For here—

Hehehe. In the past, to strengthen my own body,
I pursued the ultimate stamina dishes and honed my craft to perfection...

No worries! Having studied pressure points, I have also mastered
the secret techniques to boost your vitality!

Yes, got it~!
Thanks for your hard work~!

Really!? With you around, Trainer, I'm a hundred times stronger!
Let's go look for them right away!

Huh?
Be of... help?

She seemed completely spaced out, so I waved my hand in front of
her face and called out to her several times.
I-I'm okay, I'm listening! I can hear you!

Heheheh~...
As long as I master what's in these four books—

Here I go! Life-and-Death Acupressure Stimulation Technique: Final Acupressure!
Ho-atchaaa!

But I'm not giving up~! By the end of this summer, I'll become a master—
Or at least become 'Slightly Master Tsuyoshi'!

Here, Trainer, please don't hesitate to drink up!
This is my treat to you for today!
I bumped into Trainer, and got them to help me—

Still! Thanks to you, I got all four books~!
You were a huuuuge help!

Fufufu. Practicality comes first, after all.
And that is precisely what I need right now!

The tartness of the lime seeping into my exhausted body... 
Phew~... This is the taste of victory, isn't it!
Th-Thank you very much!

Savoring the sourness spreading across her tongue,
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi renewed her resolve.

Plus, your respiratory system will get stronger so you won't cough anymore!
Food and medicine share the same origin, so leave all your health management to me!

Having mastered both work and wellness, I have no weaknesses!
My title as Trainer's 'Most Dependable Umamusume of the Year' is rock solid!

Also 'Hidden Acupoints: Mysterious Pressure Point Therapy',
and 'Ultimate Stamina Recipes: Delicacies Edition'... I'm looking for these four books!

Let's see—
I went into town this morning to find books, looked all over, but couldn't find them...
Leave it all to Master Tsuyoshi!

Mmmghhhhh... Not here either.
Shouldn't that book be in the new paperback section...?

I'm totally relying on them instead! Me!
I was the one getting helped out all along!

Wah!?
Trainer?
I mean, in the end, didn't I just rely on them the whole day!?
Fufufu... Ahaha... Aaaahahahahaaa!
(They'll rely on me!)

"*Sigh*... The work and documents just keep piling up.
Filing expense claims means hunting for receipts first... Oh man, what am I gonna do~!"

My frail constitution is a thing of the past. Now, I am health personified. In other words, 'The Master of Health'!
Allow me to serve you its culmination: the 'Explosive Diamond Meat Set Meal'!

Gaaah!
The road to becoming the dependable Master Tsuyoshi is a long one...!

*Gulp*...
Aahhh~, it hits the spot~~!

Let's see... 'Never Messy Again! The Ultimate Organization Guide', and
'No More Mistakes! Thorough and Flawless Accounting Handbook'.

"Guh!? I just sat down in the chair to take a short break,
and suddenly my eyes, shoulders, and lower back have hit their limit~!"

"T-The chaotic mess of documents and receipts where you couldn't tell
what was where has been sorted in an instant...!"

"I-Incredible...! My blurry vision cleared up,
and the aches in my shoulders and back are gone toooo!!"

"Ugh, I used being busy as an excuse to eat irregularly,
and now I'm stuck with chronic fatigue~!"

Secret Art of Organization...
Thousand Strikes Document Sortingggg!

"Whoaaa!
Power is surging through my entire body, I feel like I've gotten jacked!"

*Pant*... *Gasp*... I'm sooooo tired...!
I never imagined we'd end up hitting every single big bookstore in town...
